'''Ignisnap''' is a [[Fire]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Blueflick]] at 3 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Azurion]] at 6 bronze stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Ignisnap evolved blue horns to better sense humans. Scorch Blast is just a way to get your attention to come play."

Ignisnap is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A red lizard with a fiery tail and tan underbelly/chin. It has dark brown irises, blue pupils, and a blue tongue. Its feet are orange and it has orange accents bordering its underbelly. It also has small, yellow horns, and blue horns on the sides of its face.

Ignisnap's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces red with pink.

==Evolution Trial==
Ignisnap's evolution trials unlock once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Azurion]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Ignisnap to increase stats 3 times.
* Play [[Marathon Party]] (use x2000 skateboards) or [[Events|Cozy Farm]] (use x4000 fertilizer).

== Trivia ==
* Its original bio used to say: "The biggest difference between Ignisnap and [[Blueflick]] is that Ignisnap's got a blue neck pillow."
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "'Feed Ignisnaps 10 times their bodyweight in blueberries to evolve them.'--- 3-Piece Trainee Guide...Hold on, what?"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "Heat radiating from Ignisnap's tail can rapidly warm up surrounding air. Always greets anyone with enthusiasm."
